gates.detail: cd workloads/game-service && npm run typecheck ran `tsc --noEmit` and completed with exit code 0 and no output (no type errors).

gates.name: Start the workload and the edge, the documented way
gates.detail: Built GameEdge DLL via dotnet build. Started game-service with GAME_SERVICE_PORT=8080 npm start (readiness: healthy). Built and started GameEdge from its own bin/Release/net10.0 directory (README requires running from that directory, not repo root, since ASP.NET resolves appsettings.json against process CWD) with GameEdge__WorkloadBaseAddress=http://127.0.0.1:8080 ASPNETCORE_URLS=http://127.0.0.1:5080 ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Production. Curl results: GET http://127.0.0.1:8080/livez -> 200 {"status":"healthy"}; GET http://127.0.0.1:8080/readyz -> 200 {"status":"healthy"}; GET http://127.0.0.1:5080/health/live -> 200 {"status":"Healthy","checks":[]}; GET http://127.0.0.1:5080/health/ready -> 200 {"status":"Healthy","checks":[{"name":"game-workload","status":"Healthy"}]}. Both processes were stopped afterward.

gates.name: Run the replay against the workload
gates.detail: cd workloads/game-service && npx vitest run tests/replay.test.ts: Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 11 passed (11), Duration 4.54s. All four named assertions (byte-identity dump comparison, golden transcript comparison, distinct-OS-process check, save-game transcript entry) passed.

gates.name: Run the replay against the edge
gates.detail: cd workloads/game-service && GAME_EDGE_DLL=<repo>/workloads/game-edge/SubZeroDev.Platform.GameEdge/bin/Release/net10.0/SubZeroDev.Platform.GameEdge.dll npx vitest run tests/replay-edge.test.ts: Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 2 passed (2), Duration 3.77s. Both edge-fronted byte-identity comparisons passed.

gates.name: Migrate the schema to head, the documented way
gates.detail: Started Postgres via `docker compose up -d postgres` in workloads/game-service (postgres:17, reported healthy). Ran GAME_SERVICE_DB_SCHEMA=ci_documented_migrate GAME_SERVICE_DB_CONNECTION_STRING=postgresql://game_service:game_service@127.0.0.1:5432/game_service npm run migrate. Output: 'migrated ci_documented_migrate to head'. Exit code 0.

gates.name: Start the workload against the durable store, the documented way
gates.detail: With the compose Postgres running, ran GAME_SERVICE_PORT=8081 GAME_SERVICE_STORAGE=durable GAME_SERVICE_DB_CONNECTION_STRING=postgresql://game_service:game_service@127.0.0.1:5432/game_service GAME_SERVICE_DB_SCHEMA=ci_documented_durable_start npm start. Stdout: {"listening":{"host":"127.0.0.1","port":8081},"readiness":"healthy"}. curl http://127.0.0.1:8081/readyz -> HTTP 200 {"status":"healthy"}. Process stopped afterward.
